claims.text: The network uses mean square error as the loss function for classification, which outperformed binary cross entropy in their experiments.
RMSprop is employed for parameter optimization during training of the network.
The output of the network is evaluated using softmax to interpret classification results as probabilities.
GloVe pre-trained word embeddings are utilized to initialize the word embeddings in the network.
